_readme: K2's request list for K1, and the overlay K2's tests put on top of the real src/data/nasa_data.json. 'add' holds entries nasa_data.json does not have yet; 'fill' holds row fields that are still null there. Every value here is a TEST value with src PLACEHOLDER, not a researched figure: do not copy the numbers into nasa_data.json. When K1 adds an entry for real, delete it here.

evaGameSecondsPerRealSecond.note: D-008: while outside, 1 real second = 1 game minute (inside it is about 740)

habitatCoolingHours.note: time constant for the habitat to cool toward outside with heating off; game value

bodyColdBelowC.note: habitat air temperature counted as dangerous cold; game value

coldLossHours.note: D-006: body temperature below the threshold for 2 game-hours

radiationLimitMSv.note: mission dose limit; NASA-STD-3001 career limit is a candidate source

suitO2Kg.note: usable O2 in the suit at EVA start; find an EMU/xEMU figure

walkSpeedMs.note: suited walking speed; find an Apollo/analog EVA figure

jointFreezeBelowC.note: outside temperature at which suit joints stiffen; game value

suitHeaterKWh.note: habitat energy to recharge the suit after its heater ran; game value

shelterHours.note: time to thaw joints with a wreck's RHU heat; game value

earliestSol.note: first sol the card may appear; game value. The run lands at sunrise, the coldest moment in K1's surfaceTemp, so 1 would open the card at landing

triggerBelowC.note: outside temperature that freezes the engine; game value

batteryHeatKWh.note: energy to warm the engine from the battery; game value

manualO2Kg.note: O2 for a short EVA; derive from life.evaO2KgPerHour x EVA hours

manualRadiationMSv.note: extra dose for the EVA; game value

waitSols.note: design doc v2 card: miss the window, wait 1 sol
